notes.title: Translation Update
notes.content:
This update introduces Russian and German translations, includes balance changes, and adds several quality of life improvements.

AdditionsAdded German translationAdded Russian translation (thanks NikSynaly)Added icon for Exile next to graveyard icon (only shows when you have exiled creatures)Added "Quick Remove" button for lacrima (backpack icon that appears when clicking on an equipped lacrima)Added "Quick Equip" option when clicking on empty card slotsAdded "Clear Cards" button in inventory to quickly remove lacrima from all cardsAdded confirmation button for lacrima/blessing/card rewardsAdded new option to enable/disable confirmations (Options > General)Added new effect for card rewards (similar to lacrima rewards)Added card notificiation for whenever a status effect runs out or gets removedAdded support for ultrawidescreen, 16:10, 4:3, and other resolutions
Card info is now shown when targeting a card with a spell
Gameplay AdjustmentsAdjusted boss fights: Chapter 1 and 2 boss fights always have 3 lanes, chapter 3 boss fight always has 5 lanes (thanks PersistentDreamer)Valefar: Changed "Steal Lacrima" to "Fracture"Amdusias: Removed "Magic Ward" from Chapter 1Demons now face up when spawned on enemy side during player's turn (i.e. after casting a spell)
Exhumed enemies no longer get revealed when they are exhumed during the attack phase (thanks Qwerty)Curses/Blessings can no longer get overcharged outside of combat (thanks Qwerty)Parasite now always starts with 2 on success; each success adds another 2Generated enemies no longer receive Heal if they already have Reinforced Shield / Magic WardGravedigger: Added 1 spell with Exhume to deck from the start (thanks Kool8987)Turned GlassCannon into a modifier (= purple lacrima)Reworked Deathblow: Deals damage equal to Bleed stacks and removes Bleed. Activation success: If 5 or more Bleed stacks got removed, destroy non-boss creature.TargetAll/Enemies/Allies effects now reduce lacrima values by 50% (thanks Arifmeticus)
UI/UX AdjustmentsDeckbound, Healingbound, Discardbound, and Despairbound now show relevant numbers in descriptionsRemoved "Mugged" triggerAdded Button decorations to small "1-space" buttons (i.e. inventory arrows)Pressing left on lacrima in satchel always goes to cards (same for Altar of Tears)
Description for the "End turn" button is now always shown during first fight and whole first runRest sequence now fades in/out instead of panning up/down (reduces motion sickness)Made shop music a bit quieter (thanks Pablo Murphy)
FixesFixed softlock when playing a creature on another creature mid-chain reaction (thanks Micha, Qwerty)Fixed rare bug where a trigger would incorrectly turn into a modifier in Altar of Tears (thanks Qwerty)Fixed preview bug in Altar of Tears when moving active lacrima to inventory (thanks BrandMChaos)Fixed issue where active map node circle disappeared when clicking "Options" during Rest (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "Provoked" not triggering on immune bosses for offence lacrima actions (thanks Qwerty)Fixed despair icons (on cards in hand) not updating correctly when despair is reduced (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "Demon" not spawning correctly when placing a creature (thanks Qwerty)Fixed lacrima from Automaton not returning when Recycle was fractured (thanks Qwerty)Fixed lacrima activation ring stuck to cards without animationFixed creature moving lanes during chain reactions returning incorrectly with 0 HPFixed Turn Passed: Exodus situation where fight didn't properly endFixed issue with status effects not appearing correctly in battle log
Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Altar of Tears
notes.content:
This update adds a new event called Altar of Tears and includes changes to decks, balance, blessings, curses, bosses, map generation, and more.

Additions:Added new map event "Altar of Tears", which lets you combine lacrimaAdded "Lacrima Pack" option in ShopAdded choices to Rest eventAdded creature/demon art by vilAdded unique named enemies that appear in regular fightsAdded new animation and music when winning a runAdded new shop musicAdded 3 player profiles instead of the "Reset" button in collection (thanks Pablo Murphy)Added highscore for deck selection and winning a runAdded sound when getting a new curse
Gameplay:Bloodsucker deck has been changed (total revamp)Mercenary deck has been changed (replaced Capture with Recruit)Fight rewards no longer depend on enemy lacrimaReduced icons on map tiles to 3 to make runs a bit faster (thanks Marc / PepperHeadGaming)There are now only unique symbols on map tilesAdjacent map tiles should no longer contain the same eventsUnknown now has a lower chance to be a regular fightIncreased chance of fights having at least 3 lanes and 3 enemies starting in chapter 2Card upgrades in Study are now capped by chapterCards with 5 slots now only appear in chapter 3 (shops and treasure chests)Reduced maximum despair from 67 to 58Reworked blessings, curses, and bosses
Replaced Capture with Exile: Exiles target non-boss creatureReplaced Steal Lacrima with Fracture %: Disables one random lacrima slot of target creatureReplaced Permadeath with Obliterate: When this creature kills a target with physical damage, exile targetRenamed Anima to GrudgeRenamed Sacrilege to PrayRenamed Hemorrhage to RipRenamed Steal Gold to MugCreature score now includes total damage doneRemoved several triggers (i.e. OnGlassCannon)Boss minions now have fewer lacrima (thanks Auri)Cards with Defender now always have 0 ATKAlly Debuffed and Ally Buff can now only be triggered by allies of the card, not the card carrying the trigger itself (same as Ally Attack, and Ally Death) (thanks Blankity)Overcharged no longer counts as a debuff and no longer activates debuffed triggers (thanks OKftw)
UI/UX:Added animated border to card that is currently attackingAdded animations for selling and sacrificing cardsAdded animation for boss card appearanceAdded animation for lacrima rewardsAdded subtle particles when putting down or moving cardsAdded gold particles when opening treasureAdded player damage particles on target lane and a red screen borderAdded more lacrima activation effects (with object pooling)Added a new effect when a card is triggered the first time in a turn (thanks Max)Added inventory zoom button, which scales up cards and lacrima slotsAdded description for "Add Lane"Added description for "First Strike"Added description for fractured slotAdded total kills to Rage descriptionAdded total fights to Fightbound descriptionAdded button decorationsAdded red despair symbol on cards in hand which will increase despair to 100%Added tip that tells you that creatures revive after fights.Tip about moving creatures now only shows if you have never moved a creature to another lane beforeMade it easier to click on boss node (thanks Auri)Exiting certain final node (e.g. shop) on a map tile no longer prematurely marks it doneReroll and Lacrima Pack prices are now red when not affordable (thanks Auri)Gold display now counts up/down when value changesChanged overcharged description to hopefully be less confusingLane sprites on the board now fade in/outMade sure that Automatons/Demons spawned from Spells always spawn on target lane (thanks Auri)Sacrificing a card now also animates lacrima to inventoryCard events now start bigger, especially damage numbersEnd turn tooltip now only gets shown in the beginning of the game (thanks Auri)Exhume now has a different description on enemiesYou can now press triangle / mouse middle click to remove a lacrima from a card (thanks EnchanteurW)Cards in collection are now shown twice as bigClicking on an empty space on the board deselects current cardCard rotation now resets when dragging it away from hand and letting goMade sure resolution is set correctly on Steam Deck
Fixes:Fixed Doomed always resetting to 3 turns when re-appliedFixed atonement details not going away after moving the mouse awayFixed status effect icons not always re-aligning correctly when a status effect gets removedFixed bug when summoning a Minion with a spellFixed redraw info not disappearing when pressing the redraw buttonFixed error when playing a creature which causes full despair and destroy the creature that you'd want to replaceFixed some cases where pressing end turn would not be queued correctly, i.e. while long trigger chains are being resolvedFixed bosses showing random decorationFixed minions mixing defence and offence lacrima for "target newest enemy"Fixed bug where buying a card from shop re-appears after restarting the gameFixed card tooltips not disappearing when destroying a card with a spellFixed menu error when playing a spell caused enemies to exhume cardsFixed softlocks when getting despair outside fights (mainly for Mercenary)Fixed case when stealing gold from your own creatures (i.e. with a spell)Fixed edge case where OnDeath trigger would cause a chain reaction and the card would get killed againFixed being able to still play a selected card if it was already discarded
Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

Make sure to join the Discord and wishlist the game.

notes.title: Atonements
notes.content:
This update adds five new Atonments (previously called "circles of hell" / "difficulty circles") and a new run starter layout.

Additions"Difficulty Circles" are now called Atonements
Added new Atonements layout, which lets you unlock new Atonements after winning
Added five new Atonements for a total of 15Added new layout for starting a runYou can now hover over the selected Atonements in the upper left corner to show what you selected
Exhume, Draw Card and Discard Card now always only just work once and display no other valueMercenary: Adjusted starter deck (+3 low-cost creatures)
Mercenary: Added permanent Curse (Abyss of Avarice)
Unknown icons on maps now turn into what they actually are when clicked
Lacrima value modifiers are now calculated by the order in which they are slotted into the cards (from left to right), i.e. Double + Deckbound is worse than Deckbound + Double
Added tooltip in shop to show that you can only sell 1 card (thanks cyangmou)Added tooltip in shop to show that sold cards return their lacrima to inventory (thanks cyangmou)Added tip to tell you to customize your cards if you haven't already after a few fights (thanks cyangmou)Added tip that you can adjust game speed (thanks cyangmou)Inventory button is now shown when choosing rewards (thanks cyangmou)You can no longer leave the shop with right-clicking (thanks EnchanteurW)Added description for Repeat (thanks Auri)"Captured" now only gets triggered when capture was successful (thanks Qwerty)Added "lacrima to inventory" animation when stealing lacrima or selling cardsAdded animation when getting a new curseAdded description for Bleed to Harvest + HemorrhageAdded info when hand is full when trying to draw a cardFixesFixed issue where if you won with 5 Atonements they wouldn't get mastered (thanks Auri)
Fixed issue when trying to capture a charmed ally (thanks Auri)Fixed despair rain not stopping when a run ends or when going back to title
Fixed Exhume ignoring hand size limitFixed lacrima in collection always showing even though they weren't discovered yet
Fixed card score not working correctly (thanks Qwerty)Fixed fight not set to done when all enemies were captured or all lacrima were stolen and leaving no lacrima to choose from (thanks Qwerty)Fixed card scaling issue in game end screen when having lots of cards in the deck and switching to "Statistics" tab
Fixed disappearing blessing rewards when choosing a blessing reward, opening inventory, and closing inventoryFixed bug when selling a card in a shop while having a full satchelFixed menu issue when getting new curse outside of a fight (thanks Auri)
Fixed bosses triggering "Damage Taken" while having Immunity (thanks Qwerty)Fixed capture not revealing next enemy during player's turnFixed issue where casting Automaton + Void (or any other offence lacrima) on an empty lane would cause a spell not to work again in the rest of the fight (thanks Auri)Fixed issue where "Magic Hand" would trigger at the start of a fight, but no enemies were revealed on the board yet (thanks Auri)Fixed issue where playing a spell with Offering + Automaton on an ally creature would only play Offering and then stop casting (thanks Auri)

notes.title: New deck: Mercenary
notes.content:
Additions:New starter deck: Mercenary
Updated inventory layout to display 12 cards and all available lacrima slots at all times (thanks Thomas Feichtmeir)
Changed Patience+ to Cooldown 2, and Patience to Cooldown 3 (thanks Qwerty)Added backface culling to card elements, so that turning cards looks a bit betterEcho value now gets divided by total action lacrima on the cardChanged Leraje's target to newest enemy instead of all enemies
Minions and exhumed enemies now face up immediately if they get spawned during the player's turn (thanks Qwerty)
Added credits button to splash screen
Added black rain when Despair is close to 100%New calculation for Best Card at the end of a run, which now also considers total lacrima activations and total inflicted status effects in addition to total kills (thanks Qwerty)
Removed Showdown from collection list
Renamed "Activate Again" to "Repeat"
Fixes:Performance: Added a card pool so that cards are kept in memory instead of being destroyedPerformance: Decorations and Card Slots are now saved in memory instead of being destroyed and re-instantiatedPerformance: Reduced drawcalls by about 10%
Fixed issue where summoning automatons with no free lane would cause lacrima to be taken from inventory, and since the card could not be placed, it would remain in memory forever, causing performance issues the more you summoned, and never returning the lacrima (thanks Qwerty)Fixed bug when showing best card (thanks Qwerty)Fixed text spacing when a spell has 5 lacrima and includes a triggerFixed issue where sometimes right-clicks were ignored by updating RewiredFixed endscreen layering issue for map nodes (thanks Qwerty)

notes.title: Run History
notes.content:
Apart from adding a run history, this update also changes the layout of generic creature and spell cards.

Additions:Added "Runs" (run history) to Collection
Generic creatures and spells now have basic art and small decorationsCards now have a "calmer" background behind the text similar to the original backgrounds (thanks Alexis)Removed difficulty circle "Unlimited curses" and replaced it with "Shop only offers 4 cards"
Difficulty circle selection now increases curse limit for each selected circleClear Buff works on Resist again
Added "Immune" buff to bosses (replaces previously applied Resist buff)Minions now spawn face down (thanks Qwerty)Improved card selection when having more than 6 cards in handMade sure that random buffs on enemies are "more" randomly distributed (thanks Qwerty)Made sure the very first run doesn't start with fights where you only draw spellsChanged Sloth curse to target newest enemy instead of always targeting all enemies (thanks Qwerty)Renamed "Water Cannon" to "Flood"Renamed "Thunder Strike" to "Lightning"
Renamed "Creature Exhumed" to "Exhumation"
Changed text "Do nothing" to "No action" when a card has a trigger but nothing else
Changed cooldown explanation to explain that it gets reduced by 1 after each fight roundBite can no longer be resisted. Originally this was called "Steal HP" and the buff Resist prevents "being stolen from", but now that it's called Bite, it no longer makes sense (thanks Qwerty)Fixes:Fixed issue when you hovered over a card while another card was being removed from the board, clicking activated a different card (thanks Auri)
Fixed "Enemy Sleep" triggering even if sleep is resisted (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "Bitten" trigger appearing in shops for decks other than BloodsuckerFixed boss not spawning in center with circle active that adds 1 enemy to each fight (thanks Qwerty)Fixed difficulty circles being reapplied from previous run after resetting progress (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "return to title" not working on end game screen (thanks Qwerty)
Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: New starter deck: Invoker
notes.content:
This update adds a new starter deck that focuses on casting spells. Also included are five new difficulty modifiers.

Features:Added new starter deck: InvokerAdded 5 additional difficulty modifiersMade it possible to click on an empty lane with a Spell if it has Draw Card, Exhume, summoning lacrima, etc.Set starting gold to 50 (instead of 0)
Starting a new run now shows whether a difficulty circle has been won or mastered
Renamed Permadeath to Showdown: Upon death, this creature will be removed from the game.Added new lacrima Permadeath: Creatures killed by physical damage of this creature are permanently dead and get removed from the game.Nerfed Amdusias++, Time Eater++, and Clumsy++ (thanks Qwerty)Added deck name to end game statistics (thanks Qwerty)Bosses now start with Stoneskin based on 50% of their max HP (thanks Qwerty)Additional preparation for having run history in a future updateUpgraded to Unity 2021.3.33f1
Fixes:Fixed bug in intro cutscene where it showed the new deck background, and sometimes it showed the map before fading outFixed issue where Minion could generate cards with more than 5 slots (thanks Qwerty)Fixed issue where summoned lesser demons have 6 attack after being exhumed (thanks Qwerty)Fixed issue where checking out bosses in collection and then trying to start a run would result in an empty screen (thanks Qwerty and Auri)Fixed treasure cards not showing despair costs (thanks Qwerty)Fixed status effect icons sometimes appearing too big (thanks Qwerty)
Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update focuses on bug fixes before adding more content.


 Bite and the trigger Bitten now only appear when playing the Bloodsucker deck
 Added active map node indicator
 Added an error message when you press Redraw but you don't have enough gold (thanks Qwerty)
 Added proper explanation for cooldown (thanks Qwerty)
 Allow checking blessings/curses/map/inventory during fight/treasure rewards (thanks DoniaCometa)
 You can now click on your deck in the lower left corner to open your inventory (not during fights)
 You can now quit and continue the game while viewing fight/treasure rewards
 Fixed rendering issue on start screen when playing the game in a browser on a mobile phone
 Fixed F8 feedback form not submitting anymore
 Fixed bug where RandomBuff cast by an enemy card would give the same status effect within a turn (thanks Qwerty)
 Fixed problem in options menu where you were able to open several option submenus if you clicked fast enough (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed a bug where flipping pages in inventory could cause slots to affect multiple cards (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed issue while dragging lacrima in inventory and turning pages at the same time (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed an issue where replacing a creature on a lane would kill the existing creature (i.e. due to a curse) and then the new creature would not be placed on the lane (thanks Qwerty)

Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Title Art, Run Statistics, Adjustments
notes.content:
This update adjusts lots of values, introduces more detailed run statistics and adds a new title screen.

AdditionsAdded new title screen art by Marcela BolívarEnd screen: Added map traversal history and additional statistics
New Trigger: Card PlayedCards now overcharge when they get triggered for their total number of slots.Example: a card with 2 slots can get triggered 2 times per turn.
Improved enemy generation:They won't hurt their allies or help their enemies (unless they target all)They won't spawn with a combination of Shield and any healing lacrimaImproved Shop cards:Guaranteed 2-3 creaturesGuaranteed 1 non-common lacrimaBosses, Blessings, Curses now have three different raritiesRegenerate / Shield / Weak / Vulnerable increase their percentage with higher stacks (thanks Lord Arugula)Example: Shield:10% plus 5% for each turn left, max. 50%i.e. Shield 6 => 40%New maximum for Weak (30% instead of 25%)Reduced Despairbound to only add 50% of your current despair
Minor performance improvements in regards to RAM usage (thanks Qwerty for reporting performance issues)Added different card borders for different card raritiesAlly Captured now only triggers when card is successfully captured (thanks Auri)Remove Bloodied from Healer deck, added First Blood instead (thanks Qwerty)Reduced controller stick sensitivity

FixesFixed multiple First Blood and Bloodied activations (thanks blankity)Fixed issue where Increase Despair could lead to the game softlocking (thanks Lord Arugula)Fixed issue where Time Eater would not work if the third card played in a turn was a spell (thanks Lord Arugula)Fixed OnEnemyAttack appearing too often in some casesFixed issue where total triggered counter was not reset correctly between fights (thanks TheRealAskz)Fixed OnAttack triggering even though there was no opposite enemyFixed issue where battle log button info was still visible after opening battle logFixed TargetLeftmostAlly not working as intended
Thank you all for your feedback. Make sure to join the Discord to discuss the changes.

notes.title: Quality of Death
notes.content:
Version 0.2.0 features a new introduction scene with Death, several crucial tips (at the right moments), and a bunch of quality of life improvements.

Additions:

 Enemies are now stacked like Solitaire so you can clearly see how many there are left in a stack (thanks Lord Arugula)
 Changed "Magic Attack" to "Impulse" (thanks Lord Arugula)
 Added new "gameover" sound (thanks KAON)
 Added animation when choosing a lacrima reward
 Added introduction scene when first starting a run
 Added several tips at several points in the game
 Added info for the following buttons: End Turn, Redraw, Shop reroll
 Added a Decks tab to the Collection menu
 Added "Reset progress" button in Collection menu
 Added a title when opening blessings, curses, graveyards
 Card names and numbers are now bold (thanks StuffedWombat)
 Cards in hand now only animate up when not currently moving (i.e. being drawn from deck)
 Inventory button now gets highlighted the first time you get a new lacrima
 Reworked UI Button algorithm for easier movement on controllers (thanks Gal from 12B3 Games)
 You can now use shoulder buttons (or B/N on keyboard) for deck selection at the start

Fixes:

 Fixed panning of attack sounds sometimes being too far away from center when enemy cards attacked
 Fixed redraw not resetting active hand card
 Fixed previous difficulty selection not working after a run
 Fixed not being able to immediately examine curses when you get them during a fight
 Fixed cards in deck sometimes facing the wrong side up (thanks Mila)
 Fixed description of map fragments still appearing after opening inventory
 Fixed check ✅ for chosen difficulties not displaying immediately after winning
 Fixed blessing descriptions being cut off to the left side
 Fixed lacrima preview showing for spell cards in hand
 Fixed card info sometimes not appearing for cards in hand
 Fixed issue where there was a hidden map fragment selectable before the boss fight (thanks Daniel from 12B3 Games)
 Fixed lacrima title still appearing after closing collection screen with ESC
 Fixed description not appearing for "Time out"

Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Art, Music & New Deck: Bloodsucker
notes.content:
Version 0.1.20 introduces a new deck called Bloodsucker, which comes with unique lacrima. In addition to that, there is new card art, new music, and a new UI.

Additions:


 Added new starter deck: Bloodsucker
 Added new lacrima exclusive to new Bloodsucker deck
 Added music for chapter 3 with cello by Lou Dunand-Vincent
 Added art to bosses and curses by Vergvoktre
 Added art to blessings by Marvin Blattert
 Added background art for lacrima rewards and made them easier to select
 Added new chapter backgrounds
 Added map animation when shown the first time
 Added animation for icons when new status effect is applied to a card (thanks Terrok)
 Added game over animation
 Overhauled UI: All information is in the top left corner now, blessings and curses are on the right side of the screen
 Boss tile now gets activated automatically (thanks Auri)
 Treasures no longer reward duplicate lacrima (thanks Auri)
 When starting a new run, deck and difficulty selection from previous run is now preserved
 No longer highlight Redraw if you have 0 cards in deck and discard pile (thanks Auri)

Fixes:


 Fixed boss tile showing wrong info (thanks Alexis Clay and Legendary_Pups)
 Fixed abandon run not working correctly
 Fixed certain string characters not showing correctly (the é in Buné)
 Fixed not being able to click on curses on game end screen (thanks Auri)
 Fixed description for ally graveyard when using Gravedigger deck
 Fixed issue where you were able to Continue after winning a run (thanks Auri)
 Fixed front of a card sometimes not disappearing when faced down inside the deck (only happened in inventory)
 Fixed header in game end screen showing "Select an event" after checking out the battle log
 Fixed battle log using untranslated lacrima text
 Fixed OnAllyCapture checking for the wrong card to trigger (caster instead of target) (thanks Auri)


Thank you for playing Faith in Despair. Make sure to wishlist it and join the Discord.

notes.title: Hex-Style Map
notes.content:
This update changes the map layout from a simple grid of cards to hex-shaped map fragments. You now have more of a goal (to get to the right), and still retain choices along the way.

Full list of changes:


 New map layout with hex tiles
 New hand layout with slightly rotated cards
 Added start sound by KAON (recording by Muddasheep)
 Added effect when selecting map fragments
 Added effects for upgrading and sacrificing cards
 Added "Return to Title" to pause screen (thanks NowOnTest)
 Added option for gamespeed, also works in-game by pressing G/L2/LB or H/R2/RB (thanks Legendary_Pups)
 Prepared for localization by moving all lacrima names into localization spreadsheet (this breaks already achieved collection - sorry!)
 Removed "On" from all triggers, and renamed most of them for brevity
 Changed difficulty circle to reduce max despair by 25 (instead of a percentage)
 Changed difficulty circle to increase base redraw cost to 20 Gold (instead of percentage)
 Card now gets deselected when dragging a card, and letting go after moving it away from hand (thanks Legendary_Pups)


Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: New Starter Deck: Gravedigger
notes.content:
This version adds a new starter deck, which starts with 10 different cards and a unique gameplay rule.

I'll also keep developing live on Twitch every other day, follow me there to catch a stream.

Make sure to join the Discord, your feedback and suggestions are always welcome.


Full list of changes:

 Added new starter deck "Gravedigger" (unlocked if you win with the first deck)
 Decks can be mastered by winning with 5 activated circles of hell
 Added PS1-style fade in beginning and between chapters (thanks to AnalogFeelings)
 Battle log now has a marker for when player turn begins
 Charmed cards now have a particle effect (thanks to medvezilla for additional help)
 Exhumed enemies now receive the Permadeath modifier (thanks Baxil)
 Exhumed enemies now have a rare chance of receiving an additional modifier that can land in fight rewards
 Renamed "Return To Deck After Death" to "Eternal"
 Map fragments with 3 Fights now turn one Fight into an Unkown symbol (if the fragment already has an Unknown symbol, it will get an Elite Fight instead)
 You can now click on Blessings and Curses on the end screen
 Added new fight header
 Music now stops after a boss fight to allow some "downtime"
 HP and ATK are now in the same text object (saves at least 1 FPS!)
 Changed rarity of OnAllyAttack / OnEnemyAttack to ultrarare
 Changed rarity of OnAttack to rare
 Added new UI click and hover sounds
 Modifiers are now displayed at the top of card descriptions (thanks Kai45)
Fixes:
 Fixed issue where you could hear the "remove status effect" sound when viewing cards in battle log
 Fixed issue where lanes weren't clickable after opening pause menu during an ongoing turn
 Fixed being able to end turn while in pause/options (with SPACE)
 Fixed hover effect not appearing when selecting circles of hell
 Fixed card slot sprite not appearing when dragging a lacrima in inventory
 Fixed bug where exhumed enemy creatures didn't receive the correct lane number
 Fixed bug where after killing an enemy with a spell, the next revealed card wasn't possible to target


Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Battle Log
notes.content:
The new battle log will provide answers as to why creatures died or why a run was lost. Full list of changes:


 Added battle log (new button in upper right corner)
 Spell costs have been halved, rounded up. I.e. spells with 1 slot cost 1 despair, spells with 5 slots cost 3 despair
 Improved enemy stack visuals, so it should be a bit clearer whether there are enemies left in the stack (thanks NowOnTest and Baxil)
 Lacrima that are activated by chance show their value now when hovering over them in satchels (i.e. Capture 10% shows value of 5)
 Broken spells no longer show a sell price in shop (thanks Auri)
 Hovering over a map fragment when choosing between two fragments now shows icon infos (thanks kabukistar)
 Removed Flying and FirstStrike from treasure rewards
 Show dots in inventory for pages below cards instead of "1 / X"
 Fixed cards on end game screen not being put in front of other cards when hovering over them
 Fixed error when calling "Abandon run" at the start screen
 Fixed undiscovered lacrima showing rarity sprites in collection (thanks NowOnTest)
 Fixed description of OnEnemySleep ("an enemy of this creature") (thanks NowOnTest)

Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Inventory Improvements
notes.content:
Version 0.1.16 introduces an improved inventory, which should help a lot with crafting your cards.


 Completely reworked inventory (thanks NowOnTest)
 Lacrima names are always displayed
 More satchels appear dynamically (up to 5 total, for a total inventory space of 30, just like before)
 Always shows 10 cards of your deck
 Add sort options for lacrima and for cards
 Cards are now sorted automatically by type when opening inventory / shop / study / sacrifice
 OnCardReveal no longer appears on enemies (thanks Baxil)
 Random Buff no longer appears on enemies (thanks Baxil)
 Changed "Reduce Despair Cost" to "Bliss" (reduces despair cost by 2)
 Adjusted several boss values (thanks Baxil)
 Adjusted the way rarity affects distributed lacrima
 Lacrima sprites now have variations depending on rarity (thanks Baxil)
 Space no longer closes sacrifice/study/shop, but still open/closes inventory while on the map screen (thanks Auri)
 Next/previous arrows in inventory are now only shown when there are more than one page
 Slightly increased chances of elite battles appearing on map
 Fixed bug where cards from previous run would appear again in new deck (thanks Baxil)
 Fixed "Activate Again" not working anymore (thanks Auri)
 Fixed issue where a shop looked the same as the last visited shop on previous chapter (thanks Auri)
 Fixed "NEW" indicator sometimes not disappearing
 Fixed card details still showing after buying a card
 Fixed "On Full Despair" on curse not disappearing when a new curse replaces it
 Fixed description for Mud (Materia instead of Lacrima) (thanks Kai45)
 Fixed cards on endscreen not zooming back out to original scale


Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Circles of Hell - Version 0.1.15
notes.content:
Version 0.1.15 introduces Circles of Hell, which are difficulty adjustments. More of them will be added in the future. With this change, the default game has been made slightly easier.


 Added Circles of Hell (selection appears after the first run)
 No more starter curse by default
 Added fixed starter blessing by default ("Meditation")
 No more unlimited curses by default, each new curse will replace the old one
 Increased default max despair to 67
 Reduced redraw price from 50 to 10 (thanks Syndel)
 Buffed starter deck cards (one Spell with Heal has a value of 10 now)
 Added 5 missing tooltips for triggers (thanks Syndel and tmachine)
 Card details are now shown for cards in hand as well (thanks Syndel)
 Right-click doesn't close end screen anymore (thanks NowOnTest)
 "On Attack" now triggers before physical damage is dealt (thanks Syndel)
 New cards are now drawn after enemy cards are revealed (to make OnShuffleDeck work after revealing cards) (thanks Syndel)
 Blessings selection screen now also shows card details on hover
 Added trigger "On Discard Card" (thanks Syndel)
 To address an issue with reloading a save file, I've now added a global exception handling (thanks NowOnTest)
 Fixed issue where card info was still displayed after leaving the end screen (thanks NowOnTest)
 Fixed calculation error with Burn on card with Magic Ward
 Fixed issue where sometimes after a fight you couldn't view blessings/curses (thanks Syndel)
 Fixed shops letting you sell more than one card if you didn't sell a card in previous shops (thanks Syndel)
 Fixed card arrow sometimes appearing misplaced


Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Version 0.1.14 - Deckbuilder Fest
notes.content:
This patch includes small but relevant bug fixes.


 ​GlassCannon now reduces max HP by 75%, instead of current HP (thanks Syndel).
 Redraw button glows now when you have fewer creatures in hand than total enemies (and if you have enough money).
